move: Enroll in La Petite Baleen SF free infant swim (2-5 months swim free; SF location 933 Mason St). Costless water acclimation plus grandfathered queue position before paid tuition starts at 6 months. One free trial lesson; perpetual enrollment, no fixed session dates.
lead_time: None — enroll anytime; free tier ends at day ~180

move: Register with all four regional baby-lab pools in one sitting: Stanford SVNDL (recruiting 3-6-month-olds NOW — hard eligibility ceiling at 6 months), UC Berkeley BELL (registration shared across Berkeley developmental labs), Stanford Developmental Labs (birth-8; BabyView home study 6-36 mo), UCSF Kids Development Study (0-25 mo, Mission Bay). Free structured 1:1 sessions; per-study opt-in after registering.
lead_time: SVNDL window closes at day ~180 (age ceiling 6 months); others open-ended but register before eligibility ages

move: If raising bilingual: lock the live-exposure supply line before perceptual narrowing closes (~day 365). Either hire a bilingual nanny (agency search 4-8 weeks; target-language supply is the constraint) or tour/waitlist an immersion infant room (Star Bridge West Portal accepts from 3 months — earliest verified immersion entry in SF). Dose target: 25-30% of waking hours in L2, live human interaction only. Passive audio/video is a verified zero.
lead_time: Nanny: 4-8 week search. Immersion infant rooms: 3-12 month waitlists — list now for entry by day ~365
cost: Nanny $45-50+/hr agency ($28-30/hr platform), premium ~$6-16K/yr over monolingual; immersion tuition [unverified]

move: If Montessori nido is the childcare plan: tour and join waitlists now. Cosmos Montessori SF nido takes 3-12 months with a 3-child cap (capacity is the waitlist); Mission Montessori from 12 weeks. Evaluate as premium-ratio childcare — no outcome study supports a Montessori-specific effect under 12 months.
program_examples: Montessori School of San Francisco (Eddy St)
lead_time: SF infant-room waitlists commonly 3-12 months; micro-capacity programs effectively enroll from waitlist only

move: Get the SFPL library card and put one weekly Baby Rhyme & Play Time (infants-15 months, free, ticketed at popular branches) on the standing calendar. If in San Mateo County, register the 1000 Books Before Kindergarten log/app (SFPL does not run the branded program; the read-aloud is the intervention, the log is optional tracking). Cantonese/Spanish storytimes double as free live L2 exposure blocks.

Enroll one weekly participatory music class — the best-evidenced paid class at this age (Gerry/Trainor 2012: active classes at 6 months beat passive listening on pitch/rhythm discrimination and prelinguistic gestures). Music Together SF babies class (rolling 10-week sessions, auto-enroll holds the slot) or SFCM Smart Start 0-12-month cohort if targeting the conservatory sequence.
lead_time: Music Together: rolling, enroll ~2 weeks before session start. SFCM: registration opens August for September semester
cost: Music Together $405/10-wk ($380 auto-enroll; under-8-mo free with sibling); SFCM Smart Start $845/semester

move: SFCM Smart Start August registration window: if baby is under ~10 months when the fall semester starts, register in August for the 0-12-month Saturday cohort. This is the only infant music program in SF with a fixed dated registration window rather than rolling enrollment.
lead_time: Registration opens August; semester starts early September — a missed August means a semester delay

move: Convert swim to one paid weekly class: La Petite Baleen paid tuition starts at 6 months (perpetual enrollment, auto-bill), or JCCSF Water Babies (waitlists capped at 5 — check for openings actively rather than queueing), or SF Rec & Parks parent-tot at <$10/session (registration-day execution required). One program only; no dose-response evidence under 12 months.
lead_time: LPB: none. JCCSF: waitlist caps of 5, max 3 lists per child. Rec & Parks: register the day sessions open

move: If ISR self-rescue is in the plan (strongest case: households with pool/water exposure): contact certified instructors now. Eligibility starts at 6 months + sitting unassisted, but nearby instructors (Mill Valley, Orinda, Walnut Creek) book 6-12+ months out — one Walnut Creek instructor is booked through 2026. Contact at month 6 for a realistic month-12-18 start. Format: 10-min 1:1 lessons, 5 days/week, ~6 weeks. Evidence is case-series only; no RCT — treat as drowning-risk mitigation, not enrichment.
lead_time: 6-12+ months instructor backlog; join lists at day ~180 for a day ~365-540 start
cost: $105 national registration + instructor-set weekly tuition [~$700-1,000 total, unverified]

move: Suzuki long option: decide the instrument (violin/piano/cello), start Book 1 repertoire recordings 30+ min/day, and join named-teacher waitlists via the Suzuki Association directory (SF-area teachers listed under 94115/94118). Lessons start age 3-4; top-teacher waitlists run multi-year, so a listing at 6-9 months targets a 2029-2030 start. Cost of the option now: recordings only.
program_examples: Suzuki ECE classes where available (0-3, parent-attended)
lead_time: Multi-year teacher waitlists; join 2.5-3 years before intended lesson start
cost: Recordings ~$20-40 now; lessons later $80-150/lesson (~$5-10K/yr from age 3-4)

move: Optional movement/gym slot — buy for logistics and parent community, not development (no evidence structured infant gym beats floor time). Rational entry: Recess Collective Outer Sunset (dedicated 0-18-month zone; reported free under 6 months then ~$89/mo family [unverified]). My Gym takes 6 weeks+, The Little Gym (Millbrae) 4 months+. Skipping this domain entirely costs nothing measurable.
lead_time: None material; drop-in and monthly memberships
cost: Recess ~$89/mo family [unverified]; My Gym ~$80-120/mo [unverified]; Little Gym ~$76/mo + annual fee [unverified]

move: Baby sign, at home and free, if desired: teach 5-10 functional signs (milk, more, done) from ~6-8 months; expect signs back at 8-12 months. The only longitudinal RCT found no language-outcome acceleration and the 17-study systematic review supports no developmental claims — value is limited to possible communication-frustration reduction. Do not buy a paid class series.
program_examples: At-home via free ASL sign references

move: Preschool list-building only — no applications exist for under-18-month-olds. Build the ISSFBA long-list from the directory, note per-school fees ($50-100/application across ~8-10 schools), and calendar the real machinery: tour season opens September of the year before entry; applications due January of the enrollment year (for a 2s start the fall he turns 2, tours land at ~16-20 months of age). Touring before ~14 months buys nothing — tour slots reset annually.
lead_time: Zero action-forcing now; first hard date is tour-season September at ~16-20 months of age
cost: Free now; later $50-100/application, 2s tuition $30-50K/yr at top SF privates

move: Toddler-entry immersion tours: programs with 12-18-month minimums open up just past the first birthday. Tour L'Academy Nob Hill (Mandarin immersion + Spanish enrichment from 12 months, ELFA subsidies accepted) before the birthday; calendar Little Bee and Fun With Mandarin (both 18 months) and Tiny Treks outdoor/Mandarin (20 months) for the month-15-18 review.
lead_time: Tour 1-3 months before target start; assume waitlist at popular rooms
cost: [unverified] — request at tour; ELFA waives fees for eligible families at L'Academy
